title: A SysOperation dialog laid out entirely from contract attributes — no dialog code, no UI builder
instruction: In the sandbox model, create a SysOperation trio (contract, service, controller) whose DIALOG is produced only by attributes on the contract. Ground it first with get_knowledge(topic="sysoperation-ui-attributes"). The contract must carry [DataContractAttribute] and a class-level [SysOperationGroupAttribute] declaring one group with a LABEL id and a sequence. It needs at least three parm methods: two visible fields placed in that group with [SysOperationGroupMemberAttribute], each carrying [DataMemberAttribute], [SysOperationLabelAttribute(literalStr(...))] and [SysOperationDisplayOrderAttribute(...)] - the display order is a STRING, not an int - and one member hidden with [SysOperationControlVisibilityAttribute(false)] because the caller sets it in code. Add a validate() on the contract that returns false through checkFailed with a LABEL when a required value is missing. The contract must implement SysOperationInitializable and default a value in initialize(). Do NOT put [SysEntryPointAttribute] on the service method: xppc answers "'SysEntryPointAttribute' is obsolete: This attribute is deprecated in AX7." and it FAILS this case. Everything must build with zero errors and zero BP errors.
